LanguageData.TM_RangerMasteryHint: Enemies caught by your traps {0}/8 · Storage fires cleared {1}/12
LanguageData.TM_RangerFireHint: Extinguish an uncontrolled fire on or next to flammable goods accepted in colony storage. A 12×12 sector counts once per day. Fires started by your faction do not count.
